localFacts.fact: ARCA-SWISS products are made and assembled by hand at the main factory in Ecole-Valentin near Besancon, France, so the original Arca-Swiss plate is a European product.
Koelner Dom: photos (no flash) and video without additional equipment are allowed for private purposes outside services, so a tripod stays at home there.
German retailers call the plate Schnellwechselplatte and the clamp Schnellwechselklemme or QR-Klemme (amazon.de listing of the Harwerrel clamp).

localPainPoints.pain: Arca plates twist under long lenses because of leverage on the single screw.
localPainPoints.fix: Use a lens-foot plate, a camera-specific plate with a lip, or anti-twist pads (English post: types and how-to sections).

quotes.text: Gibt es irgend eine Möglichkeit eine Arca Platte anzubringen die sich nicht verdreht aufgrund Hebelwirkung?
Es gibt für andere Schnellwechselsysteme (Typ ARCA), als deines kameraspezifische Platten, die verdrehsicher sind.

localPainPoints.fix: Clean pads, tighten firmly with a coin or hex key, re-check before each outing; pick a plate with pads (SmallRig) for heavier kit.
